Inside ETECH

Three decades of construction, trading and industrial work — explore what sits behind every ETECH cargo, project and crew.

1989

Built on experience. Moving towards the future.

ETECH Group is a new-generation international business group built on more than three decades of collective experience across construction, infrastructure, commodity trading, real estate development, recycling and industrial services.

Our heritage began in 1989 with ABS Construction and grew into commodity trading through ABS Exporters in 1999. Today ETECH connects that operating experience with new-generation international trade, creating reliable supply solutions for businesses across global markets.

  • United Arab Emirates
  • India
  • Saudi Arabia
  • Indonesia
  • GCC

Experience gives us the foundation.

Trust defines our relationships.

Execution moves our business forward.

Our aim: to build a trusted international business platform that connects reliable producers, suppliers and buyers across global markets — creating long-term value through responsible sourcing, transparent commercial practices, efficient supply chains and dependable execution.

Our journey

From civil engineering in 1989 to a new-generation international group.

  1. 1989

    ABS Construction LLP

    The group’s foundation: civil engineering, road infrastructure and construction.

  2. 1999

    ABS Exporters

    Expansion into trading, including the pioneering import of bitumen through Visakhapatnam (Vizag) Port for India’s east coast.

  3. 2000

    MAK Promoters

    An ABS Construction joint venture delivering the group’s first apartment development in Chennai.

  4. 2006

    B&A Prime Developers Pvt. Ltd.

    Construction and real estate development, including the Crescent townships in Tirunelveli.

  5. 2013–17

    Saudi Arabia joint venture

    ABS Construction LLP × Yazdan Real Estate Company: an international construction and real estate partnership in the Eastern Province, with projects in Dammam.

  6. 2020

    ETECH Recyclers

    Second-generation expansion into scrap trading and recycling, now operating two scrap yards.

  7. UAE

    ETECH Globe Trading FZCO & LLC

    International commodity trading and industrial supply from Dubai.

  8. Today

    ETECH Group

    Oil and gas workforce supply, industrial services and a new-generation international business platform.

Why choose ETECH?

More than three decades across construction, infrastructure, trading, development, recycling and industrial services.

  1. Experience that matters

    A heritage spanning more than three decades across construction, trading, development, recycling and industrial services.

  2. Real operating experience

    Construction projects, international partnerships and physical recycling operations — understanding beyond purely transactional trading.

  3. Multi-sector capability

    Commodities, recyclables, construction products, agricultural and energy products, and industrial supply.

  4. International outlook

    Experience across India, Saudi Arabia and the UAE as a base for cross-border partnerships.

  5. Sourcing & supply

    Reliable sources, clear specifications and coordinated movement from origin to destination.

  6. Relationship-driven

    Trade built on relationships that develop over time, not single transactions.

  7. Responsible execution

    Clear communication, proper documentation, quality verification and independent inspection reports (SGS, Intertek or equivalent).

  8. Long-term partnerships

    A dependable partner for suppliers, buyers, industrial clients and strategic partners.

Leadership messages

A word from the people who lead ETECH.

HA
“I started ABS Construction in 1989 as a civil engineer, building schools, homes and industrial buildings one project at a time. The lesson from those years still guides us: clients remember the partner who delivers what was promised — on time and to specification. From our first bitumen cargoes through Vizag to our partnership in Saudi Arabia and today’s international trade, that promise has carried us for more than three decades. Excellence Across Horizons means looking further for our clients and never settling for less than the right solution.”

Hassan Shaik AbuBackerChairman · Civil Engineer · UAE – India

SA
“Our clients rarely bring us simple problems: a cargo that must reach a new port, a project short of materials, a rig that needs qualified people next month. Our job is to solve them — sourcing, documentation, logistics and people, handled end to end. Our second generation has added recycling, international trading from Dubai and oil and gas workforce supply to the foundations our Chairman built. If you have an industrial challenge, talk to us. We are there for you.”

Sahul Hamed AbuBackerManaging Director · UAE – India

Aligned with the Gulf’s national visions

2030

Saudi Vision 2030

Giga-projects, housing and a stronger local private sector.

  • Oil and gas workforce from 20,000+ CVs

UAE · We the UAE 2031
